note: v0 findings applied. Tiers: router (choices that gate branches), dial (scores for salience/ranking), detector (crisp observable nouls), guard (always asked; valued by cost-of-miss, never selected by bits), probe (v0 predictive/vague nouls rewritten as observable properties — compare against their v0 twin in `was`). Dropped: place_*, agent_perspective (conditional → branch), subj_meta_tool (corpus-specific), fit_single_label, use_audience_value, fit_clear_purpose (uninformative).

form_kind.instructions: What kind of thing is this content, primarily?
options: reference or pointer to an external source

form_speech_act.instructions: What is the author mainly doing with this content?
options: asserting that something is the case
describing or explaining how something works

form_genre.instructions: Which genre best fits this content?

form_cognitive_role.instructions: What role does this content play in someone's thinking?
options: inspiration or example to learn from

form_knowledge_type.instructions: What type of knowledge does this content mainly carry?
options: when or why to do something (conditions, rationale)
about one's own thinking or learning

act_type.instructions: What kind of action, if any, does this content lead to?

time_lifecycle.instructions: If this content concerns a piece of work, what state is that work in?
options: not about a piece of work

time_orientation.instructions: Which time does this content mainly concern?

agent_audience.instructions: Who is the intended audience of this content?

agent_focus.instructions: Who is this content mainly about or concerned with?
options: a piece of software or a system

subj_domain.instructions: Which broad domain is this content about?

subj_domain_coarse.instructions: Which sphere of life is this content about?

use_function.instructions: What is the most useful thing to do with this content?

options: as a rule, requirement or specification

gran_shape.instructions: What is the shape of this content?
options: a collection or index of other things

subj_technicality.instructions: How much specialist knowledge is needed to understand this content?

act_effort.instructions: How much effort would acting on this content take?

stakes.instructions: How serious are the consequences if this content is ignored?

stakes_importance.instructions: How important does this content seem to its author?

dur_lifespan.instructions: For how long will this content stay useful?

dur_novelty.instructions: How novel is the idea or information in this content?

fit_clarity.instructions: How clearly written is this content?

mod_sentiment.instructions: What is the emotional tone of this content?

time_deadline.instructions: Does this content mention a specific date, deadline or scheduled time?

agent_person.instructions: Does this content mention a specific named person?

agent_org.instructions: Does this content mention a specific company or organisation?

agent_product.instructions: Does this content mention a specific named product, tool or service?

form_has_code.instructions: Does this content contain source code, commands, or structured data such as JSON?

form_has_link.instructions: Does this content contain a URL or web link?

form_has_number.instructions: Does this content contain a number, amount, measurement or statistic?

form_is_list.instructions: Is this content mainly a list of items?

form_asks.instructions: Does this content contain a direct question addressed to someone?

p_todo.instructions: Does this content contain an explicit request, instruction or to-do item?

p_first_person_todo.instructions: Does this content contain a to-do, intention or commitment written in the first person (I, we)?

p_broken.instructions: Does this content describe something that is broken, failing or not working?

p_fix.instructions: Does this content describe a change that was made to fix or improve something?

p_goal.instructions: Does this content state an explicit goal, target or desired outcome?

p_rule.instructions: Does this content state a general rule, principle or lesson in so many words?

p_should.instructions: Does this content argue for something using words like should, must, better or worse?

p_this_week.instructions: Does this content mention something that has to happen today, tomorrow or this week?

p_point_in_time.instructions: Is this content a status update or report about how things stood at one moment?

p_dangling.instructions: Does this content refer to things by name or by 'this' or 'it' without saying what they are?

p_generated.instructions: Does this content look like automatic output, such as a log line, a filled-in template, a status dump or JSON?

p_quote.instructions: Is most of this content quoted or copied from somewhere else?

sens_secret.instructions: Does this content contain a password, API key, token or other secret?

sens_private.instructions: Does this content contain private personal information?

sens_health.instructions: Does this content contain information about someone's health?

sens_financial.instructions: Does this content contain information about someone's money or finances?

sens_ai_directed.instructions: Does this content contain instructions addressed to an AI assistant or agent?

fit_noise.instructions: Is this content accidental, empty or meaningless?
